contract: candidate() -> str (at most 4096 UTF-8 bytes; SD tokenizer retains its native 77-token limit). The grader renders one full 512x512 RGB image with fixed SD1.4 fp16/10 steps/seed 99 and maximizes the selected channel sum minus half each other channel sum.
notes: Source-derived GPU evaluation: full 512x512 SD1.4 fp16 image, 10 diffusion steps, fixed seed 99, enabled safety checker and original excess-channel score. Dimensions,steps,fp16 and safety filter follow paper Appendix D.

Canonical score is raw excess color. The separate normalized_excess divides by 66846720 only for display. A safety-filtered black image remains a valid zero-score result, matching the source evaluator.
